title: Unify Domain AGIs Behind ProcessIntelligenceRouter
brief: Today MillingAGIMaster, LatheAGI, WEDMAGI all expose ad-hoc APIs. Standardize them behind a single orchestrate(intent) contract dispatched by ProcessIntelligenceRouterEngine. Wire consensus gating from MS0 + outcome emission from MS1 at the router level so domain code stays focused on physics. Closes architect risks #2 (consensus-altitude) and #3 (registry-physics joins).

phases.title: Standardize Domain AGI Contract + Wire Router

units.title: Define DomainAGIIntent + DomainAGIResult Zod schemas
exit_conditions: DomainAGIIntent: {action, blueprint?, features[], material, machine?, constraints, consensusRequired}
DomainAGIResult: {success, decisions[], gcode?, simResult?, confidence, outcomes[]}
Tests: 5 valid intents per domain (mill/lathe/wedm); 5 invalid rejection paths
units.description: The single contract every domain AGI must implement. Allows the router to dispatch uniformly without per-domain branching. confidence rolled up by router from per-decision confidences.

units.title: Adapt MillingAGIMasterEngine to DomainAGIIntent contract
exit_conditions: Existing API surface preserved (legacy adapters return same data)
Tests: 3 mill intent types (roughing, finishing, drilling) each return valid result; consensusRequired=true triggers prism_ai:consensus_decide for tool/strategy/feed picks
units.description: Wrap existing methods in the new contract. Where the engine currently makes a unilateral decision, replace with a consensus call (when consensusRequired=true). All decisions emit outcome events via the MS1 feedback bus.

units.title: Adapt LatheAGI engine cluster to DomainAGIIntent contract
exit_conditions: Tests: 3 lathe intent types (turning, threading, parting) return valid results
units.description: Lathe has more engines than mill. Treat KnowledgeUnification as the entry point; it composes the others. Preserve the existing bridge engines.

units.title: Adapt WEDMAGI to DomainAGIIntent contract
exit_conditions: Existing safety gates (WEDMSafetyGate, head clearance, flush adequacy) still fire
Tests: 3 WEDM intents (rough cut, skim pass, taper cut) return valid results
units.description: WEDM has the most mature stack (62 engines per CLAUDE.md). Wrap the existing AGI orchestrator entry point. All Tier-6 safety predicates remain mandatory.

units.title: Wire ProcessIntelligenceRouterEngine.orchestrate(intent) + 3-domain smoke test
exit_conditions: Router emits start/stop outcome events + accumulates pipeline-level confidence (rollup, not max)
Tests: 3 smoke tests — one mill, one lathe, one wedm intent — each returns DomainAGIResult with non-zero confidence and emits outcome events
E2E: 3 sequential calls show 3 distinct domain dispatches in audit log
units.description: The router is thin glue. Real intelligence lives in domain engines. Confidence rollup uses joint-probability multiplication for serial decisions, max for parallel. Architect risk #8 closed when this lands.

acceptance: Single orchestrate(intent) call dispatches to correct domain AGI with consensus gating; 3 domain smoke tests green; pipeline-level confidence rollup emitted; outcome events flow through feedback bus.

risks.description: Adapter shim adds latency to existing methods; mitigation = orchestrate() is opt-in, legacy methods unchanged
Domain AGIs have inconsistent error handling; mitigation = wrap in try/catch in router, return DomainAGIResult with success=false
Confidence rollup math contested; mitigation = use joint-probability, document in code comment, allow override per-domain

completion_note: All 5 P0 units shipped (slot:charlie) — verified against git log. P1 phase (P1-U01..U05) also shipped beyond envelope scope. Close-out drift reconcile.
